## Paper correspondence
Paper §2.2 ("The quantity modelled": the life table, the logit transform, the age range and
the floor) and §2.5 ("The tensor and its completion").  Produces `tbl-s4-tensor-dims`,
`fig-s3-obs-mask`, `tbl-s1-country-summary` and `tbl-s3-missing-year-audit`, all in the
companion only, and the data change ledger `results/ledger/data-changes.csv`.
:::

```{python}
#| label: d6-setup
#| code-summary: "Chapter setup"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from mdmx import artifacts, data, latex, lifetable, paths, plotting, provenance
from mdmx.config import params

provenance.start_chapter("d6-tensor")
plotting.use_style()
P = params()
pooled = artifacts.load("lt_pooled")
labels = artifacts.load("event_labels")
pops = artifacts.load("populations")
cur = artifacts.load("lt_curated")
raw = artifacts.load("hmd_raw")
names = dict(zip(pops["code"], pops["name"]))
```

## From long tables to a four-way array

The tensor $\mathcal{M} \in \mathbb{R}^{S \times A \times C \times T}$ holds
$\operatorname{logit}(q_x)$ for every sex $s$ (female, male), single-year
age $a$ (0–109), population $c$ and calendar year $t$.  The
year axis runs over every calendar year in which at least one population
has data.  Before the logit, $q_x$ is clipped to
$[q_{\min}, 1-q_{\min}]$ with $q_{\min} = 10^{-8}$ so that every
value is finite.  After pooling, the floor is needed only in exceptional
years of very small populations (which are not part of the baseline); no
observed baseline cell is at the floor.

Not every population has data in every year.  Three $C \times T$ masks
record what each cell holds:

* `present` — a female and a male life table exist;
* `observed` — present **and** not exceptional: the paper's observed mask $O$ (§2.5), the
  cells the decomposition is fitted to;
* `exceptional` — present **and** exceptional: the set $\mathcal{E}$ used
  by the disruption model.

Cells that are not observed are left **empty** (`NaN`) here.  How the
decomposition treats them — it fills them iteratively with its own
reconstruction — is the subject of chapter 04.

```{python}
#| label: d6-build
#| code-summary: "Build the tensor and masks (cached)"
def _tensor():
    return data.build_tensor(pooled["lt"], labels, q_min=P.data.q_min,
                             min_observed_years=P.data.min_observed_years, populations=pops)

tensor = artifacts.stage("tensor", _tensor, inputs=["lt_pooled", "event_labels", "populations"],
                         params=P.section("data"), code=[_tensor, data.build_tensor, lifetable.logit],
                         desc="logit(qx) tensor (S,A,C,T) with present/observed/exceptional masks")
M, observed, exceptional, present = (tensor[k] for k in ("M", "observed", "exceptional", "present"))
S, A, C, T = M.shape
years = tensor["years"]
print(f"Tensor shape (S, A, C, T) = {M.shape}  →  {M.size:,} cells")
print(f"Country-years: present {present.sum():,}, observed {observed.sum():,}, "
      f"exceptional {exceptional.sum():,}, empty {(~present).sum():,}")
print(f"Cells floored at q_min: {tensor['n_floored']:,} "
      f"(observed: {int((np.isclose(M, lifetable.logit(0.0, P.data.q_min)) & observed).sum())})")
print(f"Populations dropped by the minimum-years rule: {tensor['dropped_pops'] or 'none'}")

for key, value, desc in [
    ("dataS", S, "Sexes"), ("dataA", A, "Ages"), ("dataC", C, "Populations in the tensor"),
    ("dataT", T, "Years in the tensor"), ("dataNCells", M.size, "Cells in the tensor"),
    ("dataNPresent", int(present.sum()), "Country-years with data"),
    ("dataNObserved", int(observed.sum()), "Observed (non-exceptional) country-years"),
    ("dataNExceptionalTensor", int(exceptional.sum()), "Exceptional country-years in the tensor"),
    ("dataNFloored", tensor["n_floored"], "Cells floored at q_min (all in exceptional years)"),
]:
    latex.report(key, int(value), desc=desc)
latex.report("dataObservedShare", observed.mean(), digits=3,
             desc="Share of country-year cells that are observed")
latex.report("dataTensorFirstYear", int(years[0]), text=str(int(years[0])), desc="First tensor year")
latex.report("dataTensorLastYear", int(years[-1]), text=str(int(years[-1])), desc="Last tensor year")
latex.report("dataMeanYearsPerPop", observed.sum(axis=1).mean(), digits=0,
             desc="Mean observed years per population")
latex.report("dataMinObservedYears", int(P.data.min_observed_years),
             desc="Fewest observed years a population needs to enter the tensor")
latex.report("dataAzero", P.data.a0, text=f"{P.data.a0:g}", desc="a0, the fraction of the first year lived by infants who die")
```

The paper's life expectancy (Eq. 1, §2.2) uses the life-table conventions of `mdmx.lifetable` (a
fixed $a_0$ for $L_0$, and survivors to exact age 110 not followed further).  Over the curated life
tables it is compared below with the HMD's own $e_0$.

```{python}
#| label: d6-e0-check
#| code-summary: "The paper's e0 against the HMD's own, over the curated life tables"
lt_cur = cur["lt"]
qx = lt_cur.pivot_table(index=["pop", "sex", "year"], columns="age", values="qx", observed=True)
e0_hmd = lt_cur[lt_cur["age"] == 0].set_index(["pop", "sex", "year"])["ex"].reindex(qx.index)
diff = pd.Series(lifetable.e0_from_qx(qx.to_numpy()), index=qx.index) - e0_hmd
print(f"e0 (paper) − e0 (HMD), {len(diff):,} life tables: median {diff.median():+.4f} y, "
      f"IQR {diff.quantile(0.25):+.4f} to {diff.quantile(0.75):+.4f}, largest |difference| {diff.abs().max():.3f} y")
print("Largest differences:\n", diff.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5).round(3).to_string())
latex.report("dataEzeroDiffMedian", float(diff.median()), digits=3,
             desc="Median of the article's e0 minus the HMD's own, curated life tables (years)")
latex.report("dataEzeroDiffLarge", int((diff.abs() > 0.01).sum()),
             desc="Curated life tables whose e0 differs from the HMD's own by more than 0.01 years")
latex.report("dataEzeroDiffMax", float(diff.abs().max()), digits=2,
             desc="Largest absolute difference between the article's e0 and the HMD's own (years)")
latex.report("dataEzeroDiffMedianAbs", float(diff.abs().median()), digits=3,
             desc="Median absolute difference between the article's e0 and the HMD's own, curated life tables (years)")
# The large differences have two sources: the conventions (a fixed a0, no years lived beyond 110), which
# put the article's e0 a little above the HMD's in some tables, and survival to 110 that the life table
# does not follow further, which puts it below where that survival is high.
l110 = pd.Series(np.prod(1 - qx.to_numpy(), axis=1), index=qx.index)
large = diff[diff.abs() > 0.01]
for sign, tag in ((1, "Above"), (-1, "Below")):
    part = large[np.sign(large) == sign]
    idx = part.index.to_frame(index=False)
    latex.report(f"dataEzeroDiff{tag}", len(part),
                 desc=f"Curated life tables whose article e0 is {tag.lower()} the HMD's by more than 0.01 years")
    latex.report(f"dataEzeroDiff{tag}Pops", int(idx["pop"].nunique()) if len(part) else 0,
                 desc=f"Populations of those tables ({tag.lower()})")
    latex.report(f"dataEzeroDiff{tag}Max", float(part.abs().max()) if len(part) else 0.0, digits=3,
                 desc=f"Largest |difference| of those tables ({tag.lower()}, years)")
    latex.report(f"dataEzeroDiff{tag}LtenMax", float(l110.reindex(part.index).max()) if len(part) else 0.0,
                 digits=5, desc=f"Largest survival to exact age 110 in those tables ({tag.lower()})")
    latex.report(f"dataEzeroDiff{tag}LtenMin", float(l110.reindex(part.index).min()) if len(part) else 0.0,
                 digits=5, desc=f"Smallest survival to exact age 110 in those tables ({tag.lower()})")
    print(f"{tag}: {len(part)} tables, {idx['pop'].nunique()} populations "
          f"({', '.join(sorted(idx['pop'].unique()))}); sexes {idx['sex'].astype(str).value_counts().to_dict()}; "
          f"years {idx['year'].min()}–{idx['year'].max()}; |diff| ≤ {part.abs().max():.3f}; "
          f"l110 {l110.reindex(part.index).min():.2e}–{l110.reindex(part.index).max():.2e}")
```

## Dimensions

```{python}
#| label: tbl-s4-tensor-dims
#| code-summary: "Table: tensor dimensions"
dims = pd.DataFrame({
    "Dimension": ["Sex ($S$)", "Age ($A$)", "Population ($C$)", "Year ($T$)"],
    "Size": [S, A, C, T],
    "Description": ["Female, male", f"Single-year ages 0--{A - 1}", "HMD populations",
                    f"{years[0]}--{years[-1]}"],
})
latex.save_table(dims, "tbl-s4-tensor-dims",
                 f"Dimensions of the HMD mortality tensor: {latex.fmt_int(M.size)} cells, of which "
                 f"{observed.mean():.3f} are observed (non-exceptional) country-years.",
                 column_format="lrl", escape_cells=False)
dims
```

## Population summary

```{python}
#| label: tbl-s1-country-summary
#| code-summary: "Table: one row per population"
lt_raw = raw["lt"]
e0_hmd = lt_raw[(lt_raw["age"] == 0)].groupby(["pop", "year"])["ex"].mean()
rows = []
for i, pop in enumerate(tensor["pops"]):
    hmd_years = lt_raw.loc[lt_raw["pop"] == pop, "year"]
    e0p = e0_hmd.loc[pop]
    rows.append({
        "Code": pop, "Population": names[pop],
        "Years": f"{hmd_years.min()}--{hmd_years.max()}",
        "HMD": int(hmd_years.nunique()),
        "Curated": int(present[i].sum()),
        "Observed": int(observed[i].sum()),
        r"$e_0$ range": f"{e0p.min():.1f}--{e0p.max():.1f}",
        r"Median $e_0$": float(e0p.median()),
    })
summary = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["Years", "Code"]).reset_index(drop=True)
latex.save_table(
    summary, "tbl-s1-country-summary",
    "HMD populations in the tensor.  \\emph{HMD}: country-years published; \\emph{Curated}: "
    "after the curation rules; \\emph{Observed}: curated and not exceptional, i.e.\\ the "
    "country-years the decomposition is fitted to.  $e_0$ is the HMD's published value, "
    "averaged over the sexes.",
    short_caption="HMD populations in the tensor",
    formats={r"Median $e_0$": "{:.1f}"}, column_format="llcrrrcr", long=True, wrap={"Population": "3.4cm"})
summary
```

## The observed mask

```{python}
#| label: fig-s3-obs-mask
#| fig-cap: "The observed mask. Dark: observed (non-exceptional) country-years used to fit the decomposition; red: exceptional country-years (data exist but are set aside for the disruption model); light grey: no data."
#| fig-height: 7
order = np.argsort([np.flatnonzero(r)[0] for r in present])
grid = np.where(observed, 1, np.where(exceptional, 2, 0))[order]
cmap = plt.matplotlib.colors.ListedColormap(["#f0f0f0", "#2b2b2b", plotting.COLORS["war"]])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))
ax.imshow(grid, aspect="auto", interpolation="nearest", cmap=cmap, vmin=0, vmax=2,
          extent=(years[0] - 0.5, years[-1] + 0.5, C - 0.5, -0.5))
ax.set_yticks(range(C), [names[p] for p in tensor["pops"][order]], fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlabel("Year"); ax.grid(False)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-s3-obs-mask")
plt.show()
```

## Where are the empty cells?

Of the $C \times T$ country-year cells, most are empty simply because a
population's series had not started.  The table accounts for every
unobserved cell.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-s3-missing-year-audit
#| code-summary: "Table: classification of the unobserved country-year cells"
excl = cur["exclusions"]
excl = excl[excl["pop"].isin(tensor["pops"])]
excluded_keys = set(zip(excl["pop"], excl["year"]))
cats = {"Outside the population's HMD series": 0,
        "Exceptional (masked for the disruption model)": 0,
        "Removed in curation": 0,
        "Gap inside the HMD series (not published)": 0}
for i, pop in enumerate(tensor["pops"]):
    hmd = lt_raw.loc[lt_raw["pop"] == pop, "year"]
    first, last = hmd.min(), hmd.max()
    for j, y in enumerate(years):
        if observed[i, j]:
            continue
        if exceptional[i, j]:
            cats["Exceptional (masked for the disruption model)"] += 1
        elif (pop, y) in excluded_keys:
            cats["Removed in curation"] += 1
        elif y < first or y > last:
            cats["Outside the population's HMD series"] += 1
        else:
            cats["Gap inside the HMD series (not published)"] += 1
audit = pd.DataFrame({"Category": list(cats), "Country-years": list(cats.values())})
audit["Share (\\%)"] = 100 * audit["Country-years"] / audit["Country-years"].sum()
total = int(audit["Country-years"].sum())
assert total == int((~observed).sum()), "every unobserved cell must be classified exactly once"
latex.save_table(audit, "tbl-s3-missing-year-audit",
                 f"Classification of the {latex.fmt_int(total)} unobserved country-year cells "
                 f"($O_{{c,t}} = 0$) of the tensor.",
                 formats={"Share (\\%)": "{:.1f}"}, column_format="lrr")
latex.report("dataNUnobserved", total, desc="Unobserved country-year cells")
audit
```

## The change ledger

Every change made to the published HMD data on the way to the tensor is
listed in one file, `results/ledger/data-changes.csv`, with one row per
change: the step, the rule, the population, sex and years affected, and
the details.  It is generated from the records the pipeline keeps as it
works — the curation exclusions (chapter d3), the event labels (d4), the
pooling blocks (d5) and the floor applied here — so it is complete by
construction.

```{python}
#| label: d6-ledger
#| code-summary: "Assemble and write the change ledger"
ledger = []
for r in cur["exclusions"].itertuples(index=False):
    ledger.append({"step": "d3 curation", "rule": r.rule, "pop": r.pop, "sex": "both",
                   "first_year": r.year, "last_year": r.year, "detail": r.detail})
exc = labels[labels["label"] > 0]
for r in exc.itertuples(index=False):
    ledger.append({"step": "d4 exceptional", "rule": f"masked: {r.type}", "pop": r.pop, "sex": "both",
                   "first_year": r.year, "last_year": r.year,
                   "detail": f"event {r.event_id} (all matches: {r.all_events})"})
for r in pooled["blocks"].itertuples(index=False):
    ledger.append({"step": "d5 pooling", "rule": "valley pooling", "pop": r.pop, "sex": r.sex,
                   "first_year": r.first, "last_year": r.last,
                   "detail": f"{r.n_years} years pooled at {r.n_pool_ages} ages; years {r.years}; "
                             f"zeros removed {r.valley_zeros_before}; max |Δlogit q| {r.max_abs_dlogit_valley:.2f}"})
floor_logit = lifetable.logit(0.0, P.data.q_min)
s_i, a_i, c_i, t_i = np.where(np.isclose(M, floor_logit))
floored = pd.DataFrame({"pop": tensor["pops"][c_i], "sex": tensor["sexes"][s_i],
                        "year": years[t_i], "age": tensor["ages"][a_i]})
for (pop, sex, year), g in floored.groupby(["pop", "sex", "year"]):
    ledger.append({"step": "d6 tensor", "rule": "q_x floored at q_min", "pop": pop, "sex": sex,
                   "first_year": year, "last_year": year,
                   "detail": f"{len(g)} ages: {' '.join(map(str, g['age']))}"})
ledger = pd.DataFrame(ledger)
paths.ensure(paths.results() / "ledger")
ledger_path = paths.results() / "ledger" / "data-changes.csv"
ledger.to_csv(ledger_path, index=False)
provenance.record_output("ledger", ledger_path, label="data-changes", extra={"n_rows": len(ledger)})
print(ledger.groupby(["step", "rule"]).size().to_string())
```
